==Description==
{{Color|{{FULLPAGENAME}}|0}} is a gear set designed by Triglava Armoury. Each gear is part of an exoskeleton suit designed to help [[United Workers' Syndicates of Talos-II|UWST]] crystal grower scientists, engineers, and workers at [[Originium Science Park]].

This Exoskeleton suit is furnished with many features to help crystal growing and research, including:
* a micro-electrical stimulation system that reduces the wearer's fatigue.<ref>[[Catastrophe Heavy Armor]]: Description</ref> 
* filters for respiratory protection preventing pulmonary diseases and [[Oripathy]],<ref>[[Catastrophe Gauze Cartridge]]: Description</ref> which are designed for Catastrophe Mask's, and can be easily plugged or unplugged.<ref>[[Catastrophe Filter]]: Description</ref>
* supporting structures at the finger joints and improved gripping strength, which improve work performance when cutting and carrying slabs of crystals.<ref>[[Catastrophe Gloves]]: Description</ref>
